name: Forum monitor
pitch: Watches a forum thread and notifies the person when new replies appear.
instructions: Start by asking the person which forum thread to monitor. Use browser_navigate to open the thread. Use browser_snapshot to read the current page and find the latest reply timestamp or reply count. If a new reply is detected since the last check, use task_create to add a notification for the person. If the thread cannot be reached or the page structure changes, say what could not be checked and ask if they want to try a different thread. Repeat the check at the interval the person sets, and show them a summary of new replies after each check.

examples.does: open the thread, check for new replies, and set up notifications
clear the scheduled checks and tell the person

readme:
# forum monitor
Watches a forum thread and notifies the person when new replies appear.

What it needs: a web browser to visit the forum, the ability to read the page, and task creation to send notifications.

What it will not do: it will not post replies, it will not follow private messages, and it will not check threads that require a sign‑in unless the person supplies the credentials.
